name: reluctant-breath-returns-an-opposing-ally-to-its-owners-memory-when-outnumbered
notes: Reluctant Breath had no implementation. [REST], Banish self: As a Spell, return target ally you don't control to its owner's memory; activatable only if an opponent controls at least two more allies than you. Player 2 controls two allies against none, so Dungeon Guide is returned to player 2's memory.

rulesClauses: [REST], Banish Reluctant Breath: As a Spell, return target ally you don't control to its owner's memory. Activate this ability only if an opponent controls at least two more allies than you.

engineBug.summary: Reluctant Breath's ability was not implemented.
